thread:
Rina (PM): dropping a pared-back spend panel mock for an experiment — aim: reduce left-rail weight while keeping scope quick-swap. figma: https://figma.com/file/abc
Andre (Design): nice. main concern is discoverability of scope and invoice actions when rail collapses.
Noah (Frontend): agreed. collapsing to a single 'Scope' chip at <960px is feasible. must preserve keyboard focus and visible label.
Priya (A11y): chip needs clear aria-label, focus ring, and an accessible expanded state. use aria-expanded and a live region for changes.
Rina (PM): thought: chip text like 'Org · 3 projects' that expands to a popover list. popover shows counts and a short explainer.
Andre (Design): mock text: 'Scope — choose organization or project' then rows: 'Org (all projects) — 1.1M tokens' and 'payments (project) — 98k tokens'.
Noah (Frontend): prefer shorter on-chip text, move full labels into popover. will attach an info button for the explainer.
Priya (A11y): info button must be focusable with aria-describedby. tooltips can't rely on hover.
Rina (PM): token breakdown: propose moving stacked token legend from right rail into a collapsible tray beneath the timeline so timeline keeps priority.
Andre (Design): tray looks cleaner. default: expanded desktop, collapsed mobile. show a chevron to toggle.
Noah (Frontend): will implement with grid rows and a simple height animation. will also add a reduced-motion fallback.
Priya (A11y): ensure the tray toggle is keyboard reachable and announces its state; use aria-controls + aria-expanded.
Rina (PM): invoice CTA placement debate: inline header button vs inside invoice drawer. thoughts?
Andre (Design): inline increases discoverability for billing admins, but could be noisy. suggestion: inline for admins, drawer for everyone else, same label in both places.
Priya (A11y): important: identical copy: 'Download invoice (CSV)' in both spots, and provide a confirmation toast after download starts. toasts should be aria-live polite.
Noah (Frontend): role gating is in place; will show/hide by admin flag. will add toast + aria-live.
Deploy Bot: preview build: https://deploy.preview/redwood/spend/1851234567 — visual diffs: 9 spacing changes, a11y checks: 0 regressions
Rina (PM): great. @Andre please push the spacing fixes; @Noah let's do a quick pairing on chip keyboard behavior tomorrow 9am PT.
Andre (Design): will update mocks with explicit copy and focus states.
Priya (A11y): I'll review the updated mock, will add aria-live guidance for scope reloads.
Noah (Frontend): ok, small dev effort; need ~2 hours for keyboard + tray animation.
Rina (PM): thanks all. plan: behind feature flag and telemetry for clicks + collapse rates. I'll write a short spec after this thread.
